name: Honda NSX Type S (NC1)
description:
The NSX Type S is distinguished by its more aggressive styling, starting with the nose that features more angular air intakes. The aerodynamics were improved with a larger rear diffuser and a reshaped front spoiler that better directs air under the car.

There are Type S decals, an Alcantara headliner, a red engine cover, and unique five-spoke wheels that widen the car's track slightly. The rims are shod with Pirelli P-Zero tires developed specifically for the car. Additionally, the adaptive damper system is retuned. A carbon-fiber roof is standard and lowers the center of gravity for better handling.

Honda added an optional Gotham Gray matte paint color, which is limited to 70 of the 350 vehicles that will be produced globally. An available Lightweight package includes carbon-ceramic brakes, a special engine cover and interior package, and a 58-pound weight reduction.

The 2022 NSX Type S starts at $171,495, with the lightweight package adding $13,000 to the price. Not too shabby considering the current, less powerful NSX stickers for $159,495.
